author: Halley Cunnea
text: We gave KW Septic a call because our back yard was way too moist. He came out same day to pump our tank as well as replace our tee pipe. I highly recommend them!

author: Crystal Cowan
text: Highly recommended!! Truly a blessing! Very thankful for KW Septic! Ken is knowledgeable, honest and went an extra mile to give me and my family a great deal! Thank you for helping my family with our septic issues!

author: Paul F
text: Called because of a sewage smell in the house. Ken called back within a minute and was able to come out that same evening. He explained pricing upfront (very reasonable) before doing any work. The best part was that he took the time to walk me through best practices based on my tank size. Turned out I was using too much water and the advice he gave was gold.

author: Amber Rhoades
text: I had an outstanding experience with KW Septic LLC, exceeding my expectations in every aspect. Upon calling for septic pumping, I had additional inquiries regarding another service, which were addressed with thoroughness and professionalism. The level of service provided instilled confidence in their capabilities, and I am thoroughly pleased with the overall experience from inception to completion. I wholeheartedly recommend their services, as I have become a loyal customer.

author: Brittany Booth
text: Very nice! Straight forward & to the point.  Honest and explained things thoroughly. Took cash or card! Also called me back almost immediately. We had an issue during the middle of the night, KW was able to be at our house early! Def recommend. Also gave us tips and tricks to help our septic!
